title: Ricci-Yamabe solitons on the Lie group $\Sol \times \mathbb{R}^n$
summary: In this article, we study Ricci-Yamabe solitons on the Lie group $\mathrm{Sol} \times \mathbb{R}^n$ equipped with a natural left-invariant Riemannian metric, explicitly determining the vector fields that characterize them. We then deduce that, in the case of a Ricci soliton, it is expanding, whereas in the case of a Yamabe soliton, it is shrinking. Finally, we show that if this Lie group is a gradient Ricci-Yamabe soliton, the vector field belongs to $\operatorname{Span}\{\partial_{t_1}, \dots, \partial_{t_n}\}$, and we explicitly provide the Perelman potential.
